title: Sparkly key
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='keyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#FFC107'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB300'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='keyShine' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF9C4' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD700' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='sparkleGrad'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFFFF'/>
      <stop offset='40%' stop-color='#E0F7FA'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4DD0E1'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='sparkleGlow'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#E1F5FE' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4DD0E1' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura behind key -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='50' rx='38' ry='30' fill='#FFD700' opacity='0.1'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='50' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#FFD700' opacity='0.08'/>

  <!-- Key shaft -->
  <rect x='40' y='54' width='8' height='30' rx='2' fill='url(#keyGrad)'/>
  <rect x='40' y='54' width='3' height='30' rx='1.5' fill='url(#keyShine)' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Key bit (teeth) -->
  <rect x='48' y='68' width='10' height='6' rx='1' fill='url(#keyGrad)'/>
  <rect x='48' y='78' width='8' height='6' rx='1' fill='url(#keyGrad)'/>

  <!-- Key bow (round top) -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='16' fill='url(#keyGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Inner hole of bow -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='8' fill='#1A237E'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='8' fill='#283593' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Highlight on bow -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='32' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FFF9C4' opacity='0.5' transform='rotate(-30 40 32)'/>
  <!-- Bow outline edge highlight -->
  <path d='M 32 30 A 16 16 0 0 1 56 30' fill='none' stroke='#FFF9C4' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Large sparkle top-right -->
  <g transform='translate(72 22)'>
    <circle r='10' fill='url(#sparkleGlow)'/>
    <polygon points='0,-9 2,-2 9,0 2,2 0,9 -2,2 -9,0 -2,-2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <polygon points='0,-5 1,-1 5,0 1,1 0,5 -1,1 -5,0 -1,-1' fill='#E0F7FA'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Medium sparkle top-left -->
  <g transform='translate(18 15)'>
    <circle r='8' fill='url(#sparkleGlow)'/>
    <polygon points='0,-7 1.5,-1.5 7,0 1.5,1.5 0,7 -1.5,1.5 -7,0 -1.5,-1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <polygon points='0,-3.5 0.8,-0.8 3.5,0 0.8,0.8 0,3.5 -0.8,0.8 -3.5,0 -0.8,-0.8' fill='#B2EBF2'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small sparkle bottom-right -->
  <g transform='translate(78 72)'>
    <circle r='6' fill='url(#sparkleGlow)'/>
    <polygon points='0,-5 1,-1 5,0 1,1 0,5 -1,1 -5,0 -1,-1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <polygon points='0,-2.5 0.5,-0.5 2.5,0 0.5,0.5 0,2.5 -0.5,0.5 -2.5,0 -0.5,-0.5' fill='#E0F7FA'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small sparkle bottom-left -->
  <g transform='translate(20 78)'>
    <circle r='5' fill='url(#sparkleGlow)'/>
    <polygon points='0,-4 0.8,-0.8 4,0 0.8,0.8 0,4 -0.8,0.8 -4,0 -0.8,-0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <polygon points='0,-2 0.4,-0.4 2,0 0.4,0.4 0,2 -0.4,0.4 -2,0 -0.4,-0.4' fill='#B2EBF2'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Tiny sparkles -->
  <g transform='translate(60 12)'>
    <circle r='3' fill='url(#sparkleGlow)'/>
    <polygon points='0,-3 0.5,-0.5 3,0 0.5,0.5 0,3 -0.5,0.5 -3,0 -0.5,-0.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  <g transform='translate(85 45)'>
    <circle r='3' fill='url(#sparkleGlow)'/>
    <polygon points='0,-3 0.5,-0.5 3,0 0.5,0.5 0,3 -0.5,0.5 -3,0 -0.5,-0.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  <g transform='translate(12 50)'>
    <circle r='3' fill='url(#sparkleGlow)'/>
    <polygon points='0,-3 0.5,-0.5 3,0 0.5,0.5 0,3 -0.5,0.5 -3,0 -0.5,-0.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Extra tiny dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='8' r='1.5' fill='#E0F7FA'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='60' r='2' fill='#E0F7FA'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='68' r='2' fill='#E0F7FA'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='85' r='1.5' fill='#E0F7FA'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='8' r='1.5' fill='#E0F7FA'/>
  <circle cx='95' cy='35' r='1' fill='#B2EBF2'/>
  <circle cx='5' cy='30' r='1' fill='#B2EBF2'/>
</svg>
